description: A structural condition removes the rejected candidate from a query. The query union contains only the surviving candidate tags (engine §4.1 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:A %conditions $x.tags(q) = Tag-a

%rule q $x:a | $x:b %conditions $x ≅ #a

%rule a :: Tag-a | A

%rule b :: Tag-b | A
